Get PKI configuration from VyOS.

Returns generalized PKI configuration data including:
- Certificate Authorities
- Certificates (with ACME info)
- Diffie-Hellman parameters
- Key Pairs
- OpenSSH keys
- OpenVPN shared secrets
- X509 defaults
